intent: Dark-first typographic studio hero on grainy true black (or a paper theme): one huge sentence whose client name blurs and rolls in and out while its inline slot springs to fit each word.

stack.animation: motion/react (variants with a custom start time, AnimatePresence popLayout, useSpring for the slot width) + one requestAnimationFrame clock that writes the progress hairline directly to the DOM
stack.fonts: font-display (Geist) for the sentence, font-serif (Instrument Serif italic) for the name, font-mono for metadata
stack.structure: HeroBlurStatement composes TopRow, Statement (Words, NameSlot, measurer) and Footer (actions + RotationControl); hooks useRotation (clock, pause, offscreen) and useSlotWidth (measure + spring); PALETTE and a T timeline object hold every token

layout.section: bg #000, overflow hidden; inner @container max-w 1440px, min-h clamp(640px,100svh,980px), px 20/32/56px
rows: top: mono eyebrow left, mono status with dot right
bottom: border-t white/10, CTAs left, rotation control right; stacked below @4xl
layout.lines: after lead; slot + tail line 1 together; tail '\n' breaks at @3xl+; below @3xl the name has its own line

color.approach: monochrome only: page, ink and ink at opacities; no accent colour
color.grain: desaturated feTurbulence at opacity 0.07 on both themes

motion.entrance: one T timeline: eyebrow 0 and status 0.06 rise 10px out of an 8px blur; each word opacity 0, blur 12px, y 0.08em -> clear, 750ms ease-out [0.22,1,0.36,1], 40ms stagger from 120ms (lead, slot, tail in reading order); the bottom hairline draws scaleX from the left at 0.50 over 800ms; primary 0.58, secondary 0.64, rotation control 0.70
motion.slotWidth: spring stiffness 260, damping 26, mass 0.9 to the measured width of the next name
motion.clock: interval 2600ms (first hold +900ms); hairline progress scaleX 0->1 written straight to the element, never React state per frame; pauses on h1 hover (mouse), manual hold, offscreen (IntersectionObserver), hidden tab; frames longer than 250ms are clamped
motion.buttons: hover 150ms; press scale 0.97 in 75ms; arrow nudges 2px
motion.reducedMotion: no rotation or blur; every block a 150ms opacity fade; control steps to the next name on press; progress bar not rendered

responsive.phone: name on its own line; CTAs side by side at equal width; control below
responsive.tablet: fixed lines from @3xl; control below CTAs until @4xl
responsive.desktop: three fixed lines; CTAs and control share the bottom row

accessibility: h1 has an sr-only sentence listing every name; animated copy is aria-hidden
rotation pause control is a button with aria-pressed and a descriptive aria-label (WCAG 2.2.2)
hover pause is mouse-only; keyboard users use the control

content.sentence: We design products for {Tessel | Kiln | Meridian | Parcel | Northwind | Strata} that people open on purpose.
content.notes: Issue tracking, 2022 / Build pipelines / Startup treasury / Returns, no queue / Fleet telemetry / Design tokens, 2025

avoid: the line re-wrapping as names change
logo walls or navigation inside the hero
more than one serif word in the sentence
an accent colour, glow or tinted wash: the contrast is grotesk vs serif, not hue
